digest.component_or_area: tickets-store git repository maintenance and history reclaim
propositions: The tickets-store repository contains approximately 1 GiB of spent/unreachable history in .bridge_state that cannot be reclaimed by repack/gc alone and requires history rewriting via git fast-export filter and git fast-import
Bug ticket 30d3-eaf0-c7a4-497a must be executed and resolved to zero diagnostics before the history rewrite begins to ensure the authoritative store is clean

The rewrite must preserve tree identity, commit count, merge-commit count, and the multiset of identity-report event tuples while rewriting commit SHAs and removing the old tip from the ancestry of all published refs
Pre-rewrite and post-rewrite off-repo bundles must be created, verified, and retained as rollback artifacts before and after the repair coordination with A6-1

After successful force-with-lease publication, the persistent review-bot clone and rebar.toml identity.enforce_since must be converged through normal Gerrit review to establish the first live post-window write with recorded attestation
